title: OptiSweep System Overview
summary: The OptiSweep Sorter Sweeper system is a tote-to-person, smalls sorting system that works in conjunction with a customer's existing sorter. It consists of three main mechanical components (Geek+ P40 V2.0 robots, tippers, and a hospital station), a WCS controller, and an operator interface.
details: The system directs parcels from the sorter into totes. When a tote reaches a customer-specified weight, parcel count, or volume, the WCS signals the sorter PLC to stop diverting. An AGV retrieves the full tote and another AGV places an empty tote. The WCS then signals the sorter PLC to resume sorting. QR codes on the floor direct the AGV to an open tipper. The tipper's gripper pulls the tote onto the tipper, which deposits the parcel into a bag via a chute. A bagging employee generates and places a bag ID label, then places the bag on a take-away conveyor. After tipping, the WCS indicates task completion, and the AGV removes the empty tote and re-enters the sorter area for further commands. In case of mis-sort, bad tip, or tote overload, the WCS directs the AGV to the right side of the hospital station for operator handling. The AGV then moves to the left side to pick up an empty tote and re-enters the sorter area.
